Recommended Mystic Skills
=========================

.. list-table::
  :header-rows: 1

  * - Name
    - Icon
    - Usage
  * - **Flaming Meteor**
    - .. image:: /_static/{32D81D2D-8C77-4078-A1F8-FC291B80D058}.png
    - **Target Lock** Healer, enemies will naturally gather around healer so you will hit more and the more you hit the harder the skill hits
  * - **Ghost Bind**
    - .. image:: /_static/{39794CFB-E5DC-4E45-8034-E6C01A58F473}.png
    - Speeds up clearing neutral camps. One Spec Ops member is recommended to equip it.
  * - **Lion's Roar**
    - .. image:: /_static/{8CCAB359-82B2-4C20-A7FD-3873E70A6264}.png
    - Inflicts mini-stun and **SILENCE** which is very useful against healers and tanks
  * - **Leaping Toad**
    - .. image:: /_static/{4905D25F-13D1-4A46-963F-C82C3CE74D90}.png
    - Inflicts **VENOM** before using Lion's Roar for more damage (first jump inflicts venom)
  * - **Serene Breeze**
    - .. image:: /_static/{819AAF1F-B77E-40B4-8845-78DEEF0F3688}.png
    - Get's you out of stunned state. A must have.
  * - **Cloud Steps**
    - .. image:: /_static/{59B48A8C-39F1-4B46-8388-4D57ED8E5887}.png
    - For chasing enemies.
  * - **Soaring Spin**
    - .. image:: /_static/{190A87C3-749F-4D9F-A398-0BE60E6A6C09}.png
    - Cheap and dirty (hits hard).
  * - **Dragon's Breath**
    - .. image:: /_static/{F009531C-C7FF-4685-8AD0-B23A6ECF71B3}.png
    - Effective for melee users besides Nameless Sword users.
  * - **Golden Body**
    - .. image:: /_static/{A7045D4B-87D7-4304-BBEB-1CE201BED1B3}.png
    - Recommended for Healers. You need to stay alive. Use for survival. Also scales really well with Healer stats.
  * - **Ghostly Step**
    - .. image:: /_static/{EA2E6A58-4686-4915-ACB4-82C3F13427DA}.png
    - Recommended for Healers. You need to stay alive. Use for escape.
